purpose: Teach: フジモリ/立川/杜/ニュートン/ブルガリア/プーケット/ラオス/ユネスコ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフジモリ大統領のお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho — your dad is going to tell you about Fujimori and his presidency.
lines.style: Warm, gently informative. Opens with his name like you're gathering his attention. Soft cadence — not rushing, giving him space to absorb. The tone of an older sister sharing something she thinks he'll find interesting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと立川の公園行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad took me to Tachikawa Park!
lines.style: Bright, eager. Quick bright attack on the opening. Voice lifts slightly on 'Tachikawa' — this is important to him. Small boy energy: he's sharing news he's proud of, wants her to know.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが鎮守の杜のお散歩に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho — your dad is taking you on a walk through the shrine forest.
lines.style: Gentle, inviting. Her voice carries a sense of shared discovery — she's telling him something nice that's about to happen. Unhurried pacing. Slight softness on 'shrine forest' like she's painting the picture for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとニュートンの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I looked at a Newton picture book together!
lines.style: Eager, pleased with himself. Reaches for her attention with this news. Slight lift at the end of 'Newton' — this is a grown-up thing and he's proud of understanding it. The energy of a six-year-old who wants to share a discovery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがブルガリアのヨーグルトを買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad bought Bulgarian yogurt for you.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact warmth. Light, almost amused — there's something gentle in the specificity. Her pacing is easy, conversational. She's delivering a small kindness as if it's the most natural thing in the world.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとプーケットの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I looked at a Phuket picture book!
lines.style: Bright continuity from his earlier energy. The same eager pride — another adventure shared with Dad. Quick delivery, genuine excitement. His voice has the rhythm of collecting these moments to tell her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがラオスのお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho — your dad is going to tell you about Laos.
lines.style: Warm, expectant. Her tone suggests this is the capstone to something building — another journey in knowledge. Steady pacing, inviting. She's setting up his anticipation gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ユネスコ世界遺産行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I want to go to a UNESCO World Heritage site!
lines.style: Eager culmination. The energy shifts slightly — this is his own wish now, building from all these moments. Voice opens with wanting, with longing. Natural six-year-old aspiration meeting everything he's been learning.
